bullets.text: Minister Kumar inaugurated completed projects worth Rs 1.08 crore including a modern health centre with 70 beds in Adyar zone, and the office should monitor regional public health asset utilization.
Public blocked the Chennai-Tirupati road near Periyapalayam for 30 minutes protesting a 5-hour power outage, and the district team should coordinate with TANGEDCO to stabilize local power supply.
A crack reported on the Arani river bridge in Thiruvallur has caused panic, and the district team must immediately inspect the bridge with highways engineers to ensure public safety.
PMK leader Anbumani urged Chief Minister Joseph Vijay to directly intervene in the Pallikaranai marshland controversy, and the office should track environmental policy responses.
Sudden heavy rain caused joy among residents across Chennai and its suburbs, and the constituency team should monitor inundation-prone areas in Velachery for waterlogging complaints.
During the last Diwali festival, 81 people lost their eyesight due to firecrackers, showing an increase from previous years, and the district team should intensify safety awareness campaigns.

BSNL announced the upcoming launch of 4G services under phase IX.2 in Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, Chengalpattu, and Chennai districts, and the portfolio team should track digital connectivity expansion.

District Collector S. Kavitha and MLAs launched the subsidized Vettri vegetable bundle scheme through the cooperation department in Thiruvallur, and the district team should oversee smooth distribution.

An MoU was signed at the Secretariat between ELCOT and IITM Pravartak to establish a dedicated AI data center for the Tamil Nadu government, and the portfolio team must monitor implementation milestones.

MeitY approved 12 projects under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme with Rs 7,503 crore investment, and the portfolio team should explore state-level manufacturing integration opportunities.

The Tamil Nadu government constituted a 20-member Investment Promotion Commission headed by the Chief Secretary to promote free trade-linked investments, and the portfolio team should align tech investments.

Writer Perumal Murugan and the TVK IT wing raised corruption questions regarding 1,800 books supplied to Periyar Arivulagam, and the office should watch political developments regarding this library row.
Kerala Law Academy invited research papers for its 33rd international seminar on good governance and artificial intelligence, and the portfolio team should circulate this academic opportunity.
